description: Build templates 11-20: Sales/promotions and engagement campaigns. Each must have distinct layout compositions.
steps: Create templates/fashion-sale-promotion/ - Fashion discount campaign with diagonal price banner
Create templates/super-sale/ - Bold universal sale with large typography and starburst elements
Create templates/sales-product-price/ - Product + price + CTA in structured card layout
Create templates/shoes-sale-social/ - Footwear sale with dynamic angle and price tag overlay
Create templates/fashion-sale-social/ - Model + discount layering with gradient overlay
Create templates/black-friday/ - Black Friday campaign with dark theme and gold accents
Create templates/free-shipping/ - Shipping incentive with truck/delivery icon area and badge
Create templates/sale-discount/ - General discount ad with percentage circle and product grid
Create templates/new-arrival/ - New-arrival campaign with 'NEW' badge and product spotlight
Create templates/giveaway/ - Giveaway/engagement ad with prize showcase and entry steps
Each template MUST include: manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md
Layouts must emphasize urgency, pricing, and CTA differently per template
acceptance_criteria: 20 total template directories exist under templates/
No JavaScript in any HTML file
All CSS uses only semantic variables
All text nodes have data-role and data-importance
verification: ls templates/ | wc -l should show at least 20
